_comment: Corrections from two independent native-speaker review passes, applied by build-ja-travel-sentences.js on top of the generated set. Keyed by sentence id; only the listed fields are replaced. Keys starting with _ are documentation. _add appends new lines per scenario (ids continue after the existing ones, so existing ids and their audio never shift).

jtr-social-15.hanzi: マレーシアに行ったことがありますか。
jtr-social-15.pinyin: marēshia ni itta koto ga arimasu ka
jtr-social-15._why: kita (came) is wrong from Japan; must be itta (went)

jtr-food-09.hanzi: 牛肉は入っていますか。
jtr-food-09._why: contrastive wa, not ga, for does-it-contain (allergy line)

jtr-directions-04.hanzi: 電車とバス、どっちが速いですか。
jtr-directions-04.pinyin: densha to basu, dotchi ga hayai desu ka
jtr-directions-04._why: hayai = fast is 速い not 早い (early); Hepburn writes the sokuon before ch as t

jtr-hotel-10.hanzi: 枕をもう一つもらえますか。
jtr-hotel-10.pinyin: makura o mō hitotsu moraemasu ka
jtr-hotel-10.gloss: Could I get one more pillow?
jtr-hotel-10._why: kasu (lend) is wrong for amenities; te-kudasai is blunt to staff (both reviewers)

jtr-hotel-01.hanzi: スミスという名前で予約しています。
jtr-hotel-01.pinyin: sumisu to iu namae de yoyaku shite imasu
jtr-hotel-01._why: namae wa ... de double-marks; no guest says it

jtr-arrival-01.hanzi: 一週間くらいの予定です。
jtr-arrival-01.gloss: I'm planning to stay about a week.
jtr-arrival-01._why: tomaru (lodge) is wrong answering immigration about duration

jtr-help-13.hanzi: スマホをなくしました。
jtr-help-13._why: otosu implies you know you dropped it; station and koban staff expect nakushimashita

jtr-arrival-09.hanzi: 電車の乗り場はどちらですか。
jtr-arrival-09.pinyin: densha no noriba wa dochira desu ka
jtr-arrival-09._why: densha noriba is not a real compound; dochira is the right register to staff

jtr-arrival-16.hanzi: これ、細かくしてもらえますか。
jtr-arrival-16._why: set phrase komakaku suru, not komakai okane ni suru

jtr-directions-09.hanzi: スマホの地図で教えてもらえますか。
jtr-directions-09.pinyin: sumaho no chizu de oshiete moraemasu ka
jtr-directions-09.gloss: Could you show me on the map on my phone?
jtr-directions-09._why: original was ambiguous about whose phone and showing what

jtr-food-00.hanzi: 二人ですが、席は空いていますか。
jtr-food-00.pinyin: futari desu ga, seki wa aite imasu ka
jtr-food-00.gloss: There are two of us, do you have a table free?
jtr-food-00._why: seki aitemasu ka is what is actually said at the door

jtr-hotel-04.hanzi: チェックアウトの時間を少し遅くできますか。
jtr-hotel-04.pinyin: chekku auto no jikan o sukoshi osoku dekimasu ka
jtr-hotel-04._why: you make the time late, not the checkout

jtr-hotel-12.hanzi: 暖房をもう少し強くしてもらえますか。
jtr-hotel-12.pinyin: danbō o mō sukoshi tsuyoku shite moraemasu ka
jtr-hotel-12.gloss: Could you turn the heating up a bit?
jtr-hotel-12._why: original asked whether the heater is capable, not a request

jtr-taxi-14.hanzi: 荷物をトランクに入れてもらえますか。
jtr-taxi-14.pinyin: nimotsu o toranku ni irete moraemasu ka
jtr-taxi-14.gloss: Could you put my bags in the trunk?
jtr-taxi-14._why: in Japan the driver loads the trunk; asking permission to do it yourself is odd

jtr-taxi-19.hanzi: どこで乗り換えればいいですか。
jtr-taxi-19.pinyin: doko de norikaereba ii desu ka
jtr-taxi-19._why: original asks where THEY will transfer; advice-seeking takes -reba ii

jtr-directions-08.hanzi: この地図のどこにありますか。
jtr-directions-08.pinyin: kono chizu no doko ni arimasu ka

jtr-social-05.hanzi: 日本のどこの出身ですか。
jtr-social-05.pinyin: nihon no doko no shusshin desu ka
jtr-social-05._why: doko shusshin is colloquial ellipsis, mismatched with desu register

jtr-social-04.hanzi: お仕事は何をされていますか。
jtr-social-04.pinyin: oshigoto wa nani o sarete imasu ka
jtr-social-04.situation: Asking what someone does for work
jtr-social-04._why: textbook-flat original; situation text referenced a line that comes later

jtr-food-24.gloss: Could you include chopsticks as well?

_readings: Below: the printed romaji was correct but a ja-JP engine would read the kanji the other way, so the learner would hear something different from what they read. Rewritten to be unambiguous.

jtr-hotel-17.hanzi: お風呂は何時まで使えますか。
jtr-hotel-17.pinyin: ofuro wa nanji made tsukaemasu ka
jtr-hotel-17._why: 入れます is read iremasu by TTS, not hairemasu

jtr-hotel-18.hanzi: お風呂に入ってもいいですか。
jtr-hotel-18.pinyin: ofuro ni haitte mo ii desu ka
jtr-hotel-18.gloss: Is it OK for me to use the bath?
jtr-hotel-18._why: same iremasu ambiguity, plus two clauses were too long to shadow; the tattoo half is now its own line

jtr-social-19.pinyin: ashita no yoru, hima desu ka
jtr-social-19._why: 空いて is read suite by TTS, not aite

jtr-taxi-20.hanzi: どの線に乗ればいいですか。
jtr-taxi-20.pinyin: dono sen ni noreba ii desu ka
jtr-taxi-20._why: 何線 is read nansen by TTS, not nanisen

jtr-taxi-22.hanzi: このバス、空港に行きますか。
jtr-taxi-22.pinyin: kono basu, kūkō ni ikimasu ka
jtr-taxi-22.gloss: Does this bus go to the airport?
jtr-taxi-22.situation: Checking a bus before you board
jtr-taxi-22._why: was a near-duplicate of directions-06; repurposed to the more useful check

jtr-directions-06.hanzi: 空港ゆきのバス乗り場はどこですか。
jtr-directions-06.pinyin: kūkō yuki no basu noriba wa doko desu ka
jtr-directions-06._why: 行き is commonly read iki by TTS; kana fixes the reading

jtr-arrival-15.hanzi: この近くにエーティーエムはありますか。
jtr-arrival-15.pinyin: kono chikaku ni ē tī emu wa arimasu ka
jtr-arrival-15._why: latin ATM is read letter-by-letter or skipped by ja TTS; kana is safe

jtr-arrival-17.hanzi: ワイファイのパスワードを教えてください。
jtr-arrival-17.pinyin: waifai no pasuwādo o oshiete kudasai
jtr-arrival-17._why: latin Wi-Fi is unreliable in ja TTS

jtr-arrival-18.hanzi: シムカードはどこで買えますか。
jtr-arrival-18.pinyin: shimu kādo wa doko de kaemasu ka
jtr-arrival-18._why: latin SIM is unreliable in ja TTS

jtr-social-16.hanzi: ライン、交換しませんか。
jtr-social-16._why: latin LINE is unreliable in ja TTS

jtr-help-20.hanzi: 今のアナウンス、なんて言いましたか。
jtr-help-20.pinyin: ima no anaunsu, nante iimashita ka
jtr-help-20._why: 何て is not standard orthography

_emergency: Safety-critical rewrites in the help scenario.

jtr-help-06.situation: Telling a doctor or pharmacist what hurts
jtr-help-06._why: two clauses was the hardest line to shadow in the emergency set; fever is now its own line

jtr-help-04._why: kibun ga warui signals nausea or faintness specifically; the general unwell line is added separately

jtr-help-19.hanzi: 避難場所はどこですか。
jtr-help-19.pinyin: hinan basho wa doko desu ka
jtr-help-19._why: nigeru is understood but hinan basho matches the wording on the actual signage

_repurposed: Near-duplicates and low-value filler, rewritten into lines that were missing.

jtr-food-19.hanzi: カードでお願いします。
jtr-food-19.situation: Handing over your card to pay

jtr-taxi-12.situation: Getting off a packed train or bus
jtr-taxi-12._why: was a duplicate of shopping-15 down to the same situation text

jtr-food-22.situation: Leaving a restaurant, expected every time
jtr-food-22._why: was a duplicate of social-11, and this line was missing entirely

jtr-arrival-22.situation: You've come out of a station and have no idea where you are
jtr-arrival-22._why: was a duplicate of arrival-23, and this line was missing

jtr-arrival-20.situation: Any time you are lost in a conversation
jtr-arrival-20._why: replaced a very narrow line with a top-three survival phrase that was missing

jtr-social-08._why: the original only worked if the learner is an engineer

jtr-shopping-12.situation: Checking a price tag before you pay
jtr-shopping-12._why: replaced a brush-off line most learners never use

jtr-arrival-19.hanzi: 第二ターミナルはどっちですか。
jtr-arrival-19.pinyin: dai ni tāminaru wa dotchi desu ka
jtr-arrival-19._why: the e-wa double particle is a known beginner stumbling block

jtr-hotel-07.hanzi: 荷物を預かってもらえますか。
jtr-hotel-07._why: around 19 morae; context supplies the dropped opening clause

jtr-shopping-20.hanzi: 海外のカードが使えますか。
jtr-shopping-20.pinyin: kaigai no kādo ga tsukaemasu ka
jtr-shopping-20._why: a relative clause was the hardest sentence in the deck, and it carried latin ATM

jtr-food-25.gloss: A plastic bag, please (there's a charge).
jtr-food-25._why: differentiates it from shopping-17; bags are charged for in Japan

jtr-taxi-13._why: ryoshusho and reshiito are different things; the glosses did not distinguish them

help.hanzi: 警察を呼んでください。
help.situation: A theft, an assault or an accident

help.pinyin: hyakujūkyū ban wa kyūkyū, hyakutō ban wa keisatsu desu
help.gloss: 119 is ambulance and fire, 110 is police.
help.situation: The two emergency numbers in Japan, worth memorising
Pointing at what hurts. Covers every body part

help.hanzi: 薬のアレルギーがあります。
help.situation: Before being treated or given medication

help.hanzi: 大使館に連絡したいです。
help.gloss: I want to contact my embassy.
help.situation: Passport lost or a serious problem

help.hanzi: 旅行保険に入っています。
help.situation: At a hospital or clinic reception

social.hanzi: 写真を撮ってもらえますか。
social.gloss: Could you take a photo for us?
social.situation: The single most useful tourist line in Japan

social.hanzi: ここで写真を撮ってもいいですか。
social.pinyin: koko de shashin o totte mo ii desu ka
social.gloss: Is it OK to take photos here?
social.situation: Temples, shops and restaurants often restrict this

food.hanzi: 豚肉は入っていますか。

taxi.hanzi: この席、あいていますか。
taxi.situation: On a train or in a waiting area

hotel.hanzi: 部屋の鍵をなくしました。
ワイファイのパスワードは何ですか。
hotel.pinyin: waifai no pasuwādo wa nan desu ka
hotel.situation: At the front desk. This is where it is actually asked
Many baths and onsen still restrict tattoos

shopping.situation: Back at the shop with a receipt

directions.hanzi: もう一度お願いします。
directions.situation: You did not catch what they said
